intent: Inspect and refactor InMemoryDeadLetterSink without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Context Telemetry Event Ledger. @Component implementing DeadLetterSink; constructor(TelemetryProperties). Bounded replay sink sized by deadLetterCapacity(); reject stores a DeadLetter(TelemetryEvent event, String reason, Instant at... ) via nested record DeadLetter(TelemetryEvent event, String cause) and never blocks or errors; deadLetters exposes the stored entries as a Flux.
